display_long_description:
Our VR App EasySpeech enables people to work and train on their rhetorical, communication, and presentation skills. Based on different didactical modules, people can train step by step their skills. In each module there will be a VR training sessions with different evaluation focus.
With EasySpeech nervousness and fear before an important meeting will be the past.
EasySpeech will help to train in front of a realistical audience.  Before starting each training session, the user has to select a difficulty level that will lead to higher interactions with the audience. 
Each module has different exercises in offline, online and VR format.
The EasySpeech App will offer all exercises in VR format in all modules.
After each training session, the user will get an automatic feedback based on Artificial Intelligence. This feedback will include realtime metrics that will help users to work on their skills.
